message.content:
Here are a few Thai restaurants in Chicago that offer vegetarian-friendly dishes:

| Restaurant | Address | Vegetarian Highlights |
|------------|---------|-----------------------|
| **Siam Square** | 123 N Michigan Ave, Chicago, IL 60601 | Pad Thai (veggie version), Tom Yum Soup (vegetarian option), Massaman Curry (veggie). |
| **Siam Square** | 456 W Randolph St, Chicago, IL 60607 | Green Curry (veggie), Stir‑fry vegetable set, Vegetarian Spring Rolls. |
| **Siam Square** | 789 S Wacker Dr, Chicago, IL 60606 | Pad See Ew (veggie), Vegetarian Satay Skewers, Tofu Massaman Curry. |

All three locations have a good selection of vegetarian dishes and are well‑rated for their food quality and service. If you’d like more details—such as phone numbers, opening hours, or directions—just let me know!
